This is first bail application filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of bail during trial relating to Crime No.448/2023 dated (not mentioned), registered at Police Station-, Kalidevi District-Jhabua for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 376(2) (J), 376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 5L/6 of POCSO Act 2012.
The applicant is in custody since 06.03.2024 2.

opennyai_summary.10_June_2024__decision:
Investigation is over and chargesheet has been filed.
The applicant is in custody since 06.03.2024.
Conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time.
Under these circumstances, counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
6 . Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, the rival submissions of the counsel for the parties, custody period of the applicant, without commenting on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.
7. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his/her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his/her presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.

8.

opennyai_summary.final__decision:
The PUD No.473/Warrant/2025 dated 09.06.2025 of Jail Superintendent, District Jail, Dhar mentions that the appellant/accused has been released on 22.01.2020 after completing the sentence.
The sentence is proportionate and that has been undergone, accordingly, no case for interference in the sentence is required.
5. In view of the aforesaid, this criminal appeal is dismissed.
